name: Most Comfortable Men's Arch Supporting Indoor/Outdoor Slippers - Large
description: The Most Comfortable Mens Arch Supporting Indoor/Outdoor Slippers provide all day comfort and support! Features warm Italian knit uppers, moisture-wicking fleece lining, multi-layer heel-to-toe cushioning and built-in arch support. Available in Black, sizes S (7½-8½), M (9-10), L (10½-11½) and XL (12-13). Hand wash in cold water and air dry.
